hero.title: Structured applications, viewed with the candidate’s consent.
hero.body: Amud Skills brings together the candidate’s trade information, attachments, and stated language details. Authorized recruiters can publish jobs and track applications in a dedicated workspace.
hero.note: Recruiter access requires an account whose role has been approved by an administrator.

items.label: Manage jobs
items.body: Create, edit, publish, or close your organization’s job listings.

items.label: Review applications
items.body: Read submitted profiles and move applications through their statuses.

items.label: Request contact details
items.body: Reveal contact details only through an explicit, logged action.

workflow.title: From hiring need to application follow-up
workflow.subtitle: The capabilities shown here correspond to journeys available in the application.

items.title: Publish a job
items.body: Describe the role, requested skills, and expected language level, then manage its publication status.

items.title: Review received profiles
items.body: Compare declared information and attached documents. An attachment is not presented as an official certification.

items.title: Track the decision
items.body: Update application status and keep a useful history in the recruiter workspace.

safeguards.title: Controls visible in the product
safeguards.subtitle: We describe implemented mechanisms without promising a regulatory certification or a hiring outcome.

items.title: Candidate-controlled visibility
items.body: Candidates can enable, pause, or withdraw consent for profile visibility.

items.title: Private documents
items.body: Private files are served through temporary links to authorized users.

items.title: Logged actions
items.body: Supported contact-detail requests and sensitive operations are recorded.

items.title: Controlled roles
items.body: Recruiter features depend on the account role and permissions enforced by the server.

finalCta.title: Already have recruiter access?
finalCta.body: Sign in with the phone number associated with your account to open the recruiter portal.
finalCta.note: Recruiter role creation or approval remains managed by the administration.
